title: datasets/<dataset_id>/manifest.json
description: The authoritative record of one dataset: what the task is, how many items, which panel judged it, and a per-file integrity record. Generated by scripts/build_manifests.py from the files themselves; never hand-edited. Adding a dataset never edits another dataset's manifest.

family.description: Source corpus family, e.g. chaosnli, civil-comments.

legacy_key.description: The v1.0 dataset key (mnli_m / snli / alphanli) used by the paper, the analysis CLI and meta/integrity.json. null for datasets added after v1.0.

release_tier.description: score_only = final labels and human reference values only, no per-judge jsonl.

file.description: Path to the pinned roster under panel/.

items.description: Item roster file, when the dataset ships one.

arms.description: One entry per collection arm (baseline, swap, ...).

panel_excluded_from_arm_analysis.description: judge_key -> why that judge is excluded from this arm's panel analysis. The files are still shipped as they are.

files.description: judge_key (or file name) -> {rows, uids, parse_fail, sha256, ...}. This is the only place per-file hashes live.

panel_keys_in_file.description: score_only datasets: historical panel key -> k, as stored inside the score file. Keys are retained for data alignment.

paper_panel_key.description: Which stored panel key the paper reports (F15_32 for civil-comments-1000).
